description: Ollama lets you run open-source large language models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, and more) locally with a simple REST API. Many other AI apps in this list (Open WebUI, LibreChat, AnythingLLM, Perplexica/Vane) can connect to it as their model backend.
name: ollama
note: For GPU acceleration, attach a GPU to this container under Portainer's Runtime & Resources tab after creation (the equivalent of docker run --gpus all), and ensure the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed on the host.
title: Ollama
